Producers enqueue via `PostAsync()` (lines 184–196), which sends to `asyncPostQueue` (or drops the payload if the channel is full). Call sites such as `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` invoke `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` when memo-related events should trigger webhooks.
